title: On Living in the north street all his life
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：live　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 live 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the teacher ① lived in the north street all his life in silence, and every pupil in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the teacher ② lives in the north street all his life twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ live in the north street all his life at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ lived in the north street all his life before — a line in the notebook for March 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Living in the north street all his life in silence, the teacher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ live through two hard winters twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Live through two hard winters at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new pupil from the next classroom ⑧ lives through two hard winters in silence every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the blackboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ lived in the north street all his life again when nobody else would.

⑩ To live in the north street all his life, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the classroom remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the classroom forgets, somebody lives in the north street all his life twice over again and somebody must live in the north street all his life in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 居住（一般过去式 lived in the north street all his life：1966 年先生头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 居住（一般现在 lives in the north street all his life：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 居住（不定式 to live in the north street all his life：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 居住（过去完成时 had lived in the north street all his life：1960 年三月的笔记簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 居住（动名词 living in the north street all his life 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 度过（live through two hard winters：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去度过熬过两个艰难的冬天）
G. v. 度过（live through two hard winters：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 居住（后段两处：新来的学童照例 lives through two hard winters，而母亲又一次 lived in the north street all his life）

answers.why: live 意为“居住”，1966 年先生一言不发地居住一辈子住在北街，那是教室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 lived。
live 意为“居住”，自那以后先生来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 lives。
live 意为“居住”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯居住一辈子住在北街”，此处为不定式 to live in the north street all his life。
live 意为“居住”，笔记簿里 三月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人居住过，故用过去完成时 had lived。
live 意为“居住”，先生说“居住一辈子住在北街这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 living in the north street all his life 作主语。
live 意为“度过”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去度过熬过两个艰难的冬天”，should ever 之后用原形 live through two hard winters。
live 意为“度过”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻度过熬过两个艰难的冬天（live through two hard winters at once），以后再也不要提起。
live 意为“居住”，新来的学童每个学期都照例度过熬过两个艰难的冬天，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 lives。
live 意为“居住”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地居住一辈子住在北街，用一般过去式 lived 叙述。
live 意为“居住”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要居住一辈子住在北街，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和教室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，先生一言不发地居住一辈子住在北街；教室里每一个学童都说这是头一回。（lived in the north street all his life）
多年以后，先生仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（lives in the north street all his life）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯居住一辈子住在北街这件事本身。（to live in the north street all his life）
早在 1960 年就有人居住一辈子住在北街，三月那天笔记簿上的一行字就是证据。（had lived in the north street all his life）
先生说过，一言不发地居住一辈子住在北街这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（living in the north street all his life 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻度过熬过两个艰难的冬天，以后再也不要提起。（live through two hard winters，祈使句）
answers: In 1966 the teacher lived in the north street all his life in silence, and every pupil in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three terms on, the teacher still lives in the north street all his life twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to live in the north street all his life at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had lived in the north street all his life long before 1973, and the line in the notebook for March proves it.
Living in the north street all his life in silence, the teacher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Live through two hard winters at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 live 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the teacher lived in the north street all his life in silence, and nobody in the classroom forgot it.
Even now the teacher lives in the north street all his life twice over whenever the classroom asks.
Living in the north street all his life in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever live through two hard winters twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new pupil from the next classroom lives through two hard winters in silence every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother lived in the north street all his life again, and the classroom remembered that half.
